subject: Request: Exec approval for 25% Hosted API rate exception — CuraGenome
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena@curagenome.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing for pilot and research discount

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team's excited about the latency and evals tooling. We're a small academic spinout (CuraGenome) running a four-month translational study and our budget is extremely constrained. We have committed usage projected at ~6M tokens/month initially, ramping to ~18M tokens/month by month 4.

Our procurement team asked whether Redwood can provide a 25% discount on Hosted API usage for the 12-month period following the pilot. We understand that's outside standard published tiers but this study's success could lead to a research partnership and joint publication — potential marketing value for Redwood.

I've attached our Q2 usage snapshot. Can you advise next steps and whether an exec exception is required?

Best,
Lena Park
Director of Bioinformatics
CuraGenome

Attachments: CuraGenome_Q2_usage_report.csv
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pricing for pilot and research discount — request for exec approval (CuraGenome)

Team — forwarding an inbound ask from CuraGenome: they want a 25% off Hosted API usage rate for a 12-month post-pilot period. Key facts below:

- Current ask: 25% recurring discount on per-token usage for 12 months after pilot
- Pilot usage: projected 6M tokens/month, ramp to 18M/month by month 4; estimated first-year bill (without discount): ~$240k ARR; with 25% discount: ~$180k ARR
- Strategic upside: potential research partnership + co-marketing and early reference in genomics; long-term upsell likely if model reliability holds
- Constraints: CuraGenome's funding is grant-driven — procurement needs the discount documented before legal will sign SOW

Options I propose:
1) Approve a 25% recurring discount for 12 months contingent on signing the attached SOW amendment and a minimum 12-month commitment; or
2) Offer a one-time onboarding credit equivalent to 25% of the first three months' usage instead of a recurring discount (less revenue impact).

I've attached the proposed SOW v3 and their Q2 usage. Requesting senior sign-off for option 1. If approved, legal will prepare an amendment; finance has tentative numbers and will accept the revenue recognition under the commit.

Please see short note from their director below (original email).

—Neha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: Proposed_SOW_CuraGenome_v3.pdf; CuraGenome_Q2_usage_report.csv
